description: This Java source file defines the MrpServices class which provides various static methods for managing Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP) processes, including initializing MRP events, executing MRP calculations, processing bill of materials, and handling inventory and requirement data within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MrpServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing Manufacturing Resource Planning (MRP) processes within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: initMrpEvents
methods.description: Initializes MRP events by clearing old data, loading orders, requirements, and forecasts, and creating initial MRP event records.

methods.name: executeMrp
methods.description: Runs the MRP process for a given facility and product, calculating requirements, stock levels, and generating necessary procurement or production actions.

methods.name: findProductMrpQoh
methods.description: Retrieves the quantity on hand (QOH) for a product in a specific facility, used to determine stock levels for MRP.

methods.name: logMrpError
methods.description: Logs an error event related to a specific product and MRP process, recording it in the database.

methods.name: processBomComponent
methods.description: Processes the bill of materials components for a product, creating MRP requirement events for each component based on the BOM.
